heroVerse: “Give, and it shall be given unto you...” — Luke 6:38
intro: Your giving advances the Kingdom of God and supports the prophetic mandate of this house. We thank you for your faithful partnership in tithes, offerings, and special seeds.

methods.title: Tithe
methods.description: Honoring God with the firstfruits of your increase, opening the heavens over your life and finances.

methods.title: Offering
methods.description: A free-will gift of worship that supports the day-to-day operations and ministry work of the church.

methods.title: Special Seed
methods.description: Prophetic giving towards special church projects, missions, and Kingdom expansion.

bankDetails.bankName: To be provided by church administration

note: In the meantime, you may give via bank transfer or in person during service.
